title: How to Measure Gender Bias in Machine Translation: Optimal Translators, Multiple Reference Points

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the gendered pronouns (e.g., "he" vs "she") generated in English translations of gender-neutral Hungarian sentences containing occupations against three baselines: objective male-to-female employment statistics in Hungary, objective male-to-female employment statistics in the USA, and the perceived femininity/masculinity of those occupations based on survey data.
